F-moose-backcountry-0029.name: 920 m E of Middle Findlay Creek
F-moose-backcountry-0029.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
F-moose-backcountry-0029.parkWhat: pull off on Sec13 FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: 3 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 0.3 ha, 640 m E.
Moose winter range u-4-008 unit 70150 (official), 480 m W. Counts from November.

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Cranbrook, about 85 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.0257, -116.19975, pull off on Sec13 FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.3 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 865 m, about 192 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 630 m E of the spot at 2,312 m (50.01662, -116.26299). Water: unnamed wetland 180 m S (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-26, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.
